note: State-level schemes for Uttar Pradesh. Includes one deliberately superseded rule version (up-old-age-pension 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0) so that version-aware retrieval and the audit trail are exercised by real data rather than a synthetic fixture.

schemes.name: UP Vridhavastha Pension (Old Age Pension)
schemes.ministry: Directorate of Social Welfare, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to persons aged 60 and above whose family income is within the prescribed ceiling.
schemes.description: State old-age pension, paid quarterly into the beneficiary's bank account.

criteria.description: The applicant must be aged 60 or above.
criteria.citation: UP Social Welfare Dept. G.O. on Vridhavastha Pension, cl. 2(a)

criteria.description: The applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
criteria.citation: UP Social Welfare Dept. G.O., cl. 2(b)

criteria.description: Rural family annual income must not exceed Rs 56,460.
criteria.citation: UP Social Welfare Dept. G.O., cl. 2(c) (revised income ceiling)

criteria.description: An Aadhaar-linked bank account is required.
criteria.citation: UP Social Welfare Dept. G.O., cl. 4

schemes.name: UP Vridhavastha Pension (Old Age Pension) — superseded rule set
schemes.ministry: Directorate of Social Welfare, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 500 to persons aged 60 and above, under the pre-2024 income ceiling.
schemes.description: Superseded version, retained so that decisions taken before April 2024 remain reproducible.

criteria.description: The applicant must be aged 60 or above.
criteria.citation: UP Social Welfare Dept. G.O. (pre-2024), cl. 2(a)

criteria.description: Rural family annual income must not exceed Rs 46,080.
criteria.citation: UP Social Welfare Dept. G.O. (pre-2024), cl. 2(c)

schemes.name: UP Nirashrit Mahila Pension (Destitute Women Pension)
schemes.ministry: Directorate of Women Welfare, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to destitute women and widows.
schemes.description: State pension for widowed or destitute women, additive to the central NSAP widow pension.

criteria.description: The household must include a widowed or destitute woman.
criteria.citation: UP Women Welfare Dept. G.O. on Nirashrit Mahila Pension, cl. 2(a)

criteria.description: The applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
criteria.citation: UP Women Welfare Dept. G.O., cl. 2(b)

criteria.description: Family annual income must not exceed Rs 2 lakh.
criteria.citation: UP Women Welfare Dept. G.O., cl. 2(c)

schemes.name: UP Divyangjan Bharan Poshan Anudan (Disability Pension)
schemes.ministry: Directorate of Divyangjan Empowerment, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly maintenance grant of Rs 1,000 to persons with 40 per cent or greater disability.
schemes.description: State maintenance allowance for persons with disability.

criteria.description: The household must include a member with at least 40 per cent disability.
The applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
Rural family annual income must not exceed Rs 46,080.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
schemes.ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Cash transfer of Rs 25,000 to a girl child across six stages from birth to graduation.
schemes.description: Conditional cash transfer to improve the sex ratio and girls' education outcomes; up to two girls per family.

criteria.description: The household must include a girl child eligible at one of the scheme's stages.
The family must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
Family annual income must not exceed Rs 3 lakh.
The scheme is limited to a maximum of two girls per family.

schemes.name: UP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board Assistance
schemes.benefit_summary: Registered construction workers receive maternity, education, marriage, medical and accident assistance from the welfare board cess fund.
schemes.description: Umbrella of welfare benefits for registered building and other construction workers.

criteria.description: At least one member must be a building or other construction worker.
criteria.citation: BOCW Act 1996, s. 12 read with UP Welfare Board Rules

criteria.description: The worker must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh welfare board.
criteria.citation: UP BOCW Welfare Board Rules, r. 4

criteria.description: The worker must be at least 18 years old.
